column3: Outdated (conclusion B, accepted by the user Nov 5; ruling 2006-02-01): correct under the single once-per-combat 'becoming blocked' rule, CR 309.4 from the CR of 2006-05-01 to the CR of 2009-05-01 ('trigger only at the first point the creature becomes blocked that combat ... but only if the attacking creature hadn't yet been blocked that combat'), which the M10 CR (effective 2009-07-11) deleted, splitting the trigger forms into 509.4a-g; the CR effective 2010-02-01 added to the 'becomes blocked by a creature' form 'In addition, it will trigger if a creature is put onto the battlefield blocking that creature', today's 509.3d (dated from the archived CR texts, github.com/pit142857/mtg-cr), so the new Aetherplasm triggers Deathgazer again (register put-onto-battlefield-blocking-retriggers-becomes-blocked-by, decided; logged in docs/RULING_DISCREPANCIES.md); the first sentence (it may put itself back) is tested in tests/rulings/r_p006_activated_bounce.rs
